## Extraction ledger — COMPLETE

Every FAIL, PARTIAL and smaller observation in this run now has a card. This record stays open as the aggregation node and carries `tracking`, so the triage seat skips it and it is not itself a dispatch candidate.

| Run item | Finding | Card | Lane |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `chart-type-matrix` (FAIL) | `combo` widgets render as grouped bars — no `combo` in `CHART_TYPE_MAP`, and `chartConfigPresentation()` refuses to forward `series`/`xAxis`/`yAxis` on the dataset path | objectstack-ai/objectui#4229 | objectui |
| `saved-report-ownership` (FAIL) | **SECURITY** — `DELETE /reports/:id` answers 500 cross-owner but 204 for a nonexistent id: an enumeration oracle over other users' report ids | #7523 | `domain:cli` |
| `system-overview-live-counts` (PARTIAL) | "Total Users" is really users created in the last 7 days; "Active Sessions" counts every session — plus the once-observed null-keyed blank widget | #7531 | `domain:metadata` |
| `global-filters-rescope` (PARTIAL) | **No card** — the unproven half is `blocked(environment)` (showcase installed read-only, Studio Publish disabled), not a defect. The drive half was proven by other means. | — | — |
| Smaller obs | The metadata door accepts a dataset binding that names nothing (200 on save **and** publish) — referential integrity enforced only at runtime | #7529 | `domain:metadata` |
| Smaller obs | Ops dashboard `globalFilter` declares task statuses but also lands on `showcase_project.status`, zeroing those tiles | #7568 | `domain:metadata` |
| Smaller obs | `dateRange` "Custom…" picker did not open under automation | #7570 | ⚠️ **no lane** (see below) |

The 6 PASS items produced no cards, as expected.

### #7570 is deliberately filed as an unconfirmed observation, not a defect

The run itself declined to file it, and that judgement is preserved rather than overridden: the evidence is automation-only, single-occurrence, and taken on vendored console `09987b68` while objectui `origin/main` was ~138 commits ahead. Its `## Root cause` section says **"Not located by the run"**, and it names the required next step — re-drive on a current console build, manually and under automation. If it reproduces it becomes an objectui card; if not it closes as an automation artifact. It carries no `domain:*` because there is nothing to fix in this repo unless it reproduces, and then the fix is in objectui.

Recording this explicitly so a later sweep does not read the missing lane label as an oversight and "helpfully" route a non-defect into someone's queue.

### On #4229 — the design tension is in the card, not resolved by it

The run found that objectui `origin/main`'s `widgetDispatch.ts` routes `combo` as a `SERIES_CHART_TYPES` member, commenting *"the chart renderer has always drawn it (it derives the base family from the series)"* — while on the dataset path those series are exactly what `DatasetWidget` refuses to forward. Two parts of the same codebase disagree about whether `combo` is supported. The card carries that contradiction rather than picking a side.

Also recorded there, untested rather than ticked: `kpi` / `gauge` / `solid-gauge` / `bullet` all render **value-only**, pixel-identical to `metric` — no dial, no arc, no bullet target band for any of them.

### Stale-premise status

Checked against PRs merged since 2026-08-10; none of these appears already fixed. The check matters on this batch: a sibling card (#7524, approvals run) was closed because PR #7395 had fixed its defect hours after build `a86db175` was cut.
